verdicts.human_summary: Don't re-export the react-aria live announcer functions as it would become a public API; just use the react-aria component directly since nothing is modified.
verdicts.reasoning: The AI comments about public API concerns (AI Comments 3 and 7) are specifically about the toHaveLiveRegion test matcher being included in production exports. None of the AI comments address the human's specific concern about re-exporting announce/clearAnnouncer/destroyAnnouncer from @react-aria/live-announcer, which unnecessarily makes those functions part of Storybook's own public API when they could be used directly from the react-aria package.
